text: The Dupont by the Castle BIA is currently implementing the first phase of its Streetscape Master Plan to provide a vibrant and welcoming streetscape for visitors and for people living and working in the area. Phase one is the creation of new landscaped seating area 'Dupont Wendat Square' on Huron Street from Dupont Street to the CPR right-of-way. There is a proposed electrical connection and the BIA intends to periodically apply to Transportation Services for temporary road closures of Huron Street to use the new space for seasonal festivals. Three existing parking spaces are proposed to be permanently removed to facilitate the new installation. There are two adjacent surface parking lots on either side of the seating area.
